title: Open Problems and Fundamental Limitations of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis examining how RLHF finetuning, mode collapse, and the selection effects of human evaluators cause language models to systematically favor and express a narrow distribution of specific political ideologies.

Analyzing the theoretical and empirical impacts of unrepresentative human annotator demographics (e.g., skewed distributions in nationality, race, and age) and pretraining data on the amplification of implicit biases and the disruption of distributional preferences like gender balance.
